verdict.rationale: Obsidian publishes dedicated developer docs for building TypeScript plugins, including a tutorial that compiles a sample plugin from source and loads it into the app. A public obsidian-api repo documents interfaces such as Vault. Community reports of third-party plugins (Dataview, Text-Generator, Git, a CRDT collaboration plugin) independently corroborate that developers build against this API. Missing for 10: evidence of the API reference's breadth beyond a single interface excerpt, and hands-on developer feedback on the quality of the SDK and docs.
